def process(bostonPrecip, amherstPrecip, chathamPrecip, ashburnhamPrecip) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    def extract_total(df: pd.DataFrame, region: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
        d = df.copy()
        d['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(d['Year'], errors='coerce')
        d = d[d['Year'] == 2020]
        # Coerce month values to numeric; treat 'M' (missing) and other non-numeric as NaN
        for m in ['Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug']:
            d[m] = pd.to_numeric(d[m], errors='coerce')
        d['jjaTotal'] = d[['Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug']].sum(axis=1, skipna=True)
        return pd.DataFrame([{
            'region': region,
            'Jun': d['Jun'].iloc[0] if len(d) else pd.NA,
            'Jul': d['Jul'].iloc[0] if len(d) else pd.NA,
            'Aug': d['Aug'].iloc[0] if len(d) else pd.NA,
            'jjaTotal': d['jjaTotal'].iloc[0] if len(d) else pd.NA,
        }])

    out = pd.concat([
        extract_total(bostonPrecip, 'Boston'),
        extract_total(chathamPrecip, 'Chatham'),
        extract_total(amherstPrecip, 'Amherst'),
        extract_total(ashburnhamPrecip, 'Ashburnham'),
    ], ignore_index=True)

    out['jjaTotal'] = pd.to_numeric(out['jjaTotal'], errors='coerce')
    out = out.sort_values(['jjaTotal', 'region'], ascending=[False, True]).reset_index(drop=True)
    return out
